wholePhysicalScope: The fortified Saint Catherine’s Monastery as seen in April 2011, including the granite curtain walls, entrance and buttresses, Transfiguration Basilica, bell tower, Fatimid mosque with minaret, Kléber Tower and the mapped ranges inside the enclosure.
lodDetails: All levels retain the stepped enclosure, basilica, campanile, minaret and terraced ranges. Closer levels add arched openings, timber galleries, stone ledges and the forecourt wall.
limitations: The natural field is retained as sampled. Its grid does not represent masonry courtyard terraces, survey elevations or the paths below the wall.

Native geometry controls the building footprints and most of the outer wall. Wall thickness follows the UNESCO nomination. Local crown profile, buttress projections, narrow entrance and lower retaining wall geometry are estimates matched to the panorama.

Basilica, cloister ranges, minaret and bell tower use estimated ridge heights and simplified openings. A courtyard gallery is reconstructed from the visible elevations and surrounding native boundaries.
The model represents the exterior in April 2011. Small inscriptions, interior chapels, the orchard, and later visitor paths are outside the modeled scope.
